Brand Strategy

A lifestyle and learning brand,
not just a retailer

The strategy positions KAC to lead with calm visuals and rich storytelling — integrating plant care as an emotional narrative and building trust through transparency and aesthetics in equal measure.

KAC Exotic Plant Collective

Nurturing

Soft tone of voice, educational, empathetic customer support. Speak to the reader, not at them.

Modern

Minimal, design-led visuals. Confident but not loud — letting the plants and stories do the talking.

Grounded

Rooted in authenticity and nature's rhythm. Transparent about sourcing, honest about care challenges.

Overview

Designing for people who buy calm

KAC Exotic Plant Collective is a modern online retailer for rare and exotic houseplants. The brand strategy and identity positions KAC not as a plant shop, but as a lifestyle and learning brand — drawing on the insight that design-conscious urban buyers are seeking calm, competence and connection, not just décor. The identity uses a considered palette of terracotta, dusty botanical purple and deep forest teal, paired with Josefin Sans for its elegant geometry. The e-commerce design translates this directly into the customer journey — cream parchment surfaces, generous white space and rich plant photography that allows each specimen to breathe.
